pivot_ref: PIVOT_RECORD.md DL-37 — blackhornet becomes a runtime layer (11 execution seats + mission pipeline) inside DhaherOS

seats.name: researcher
seats.description: Queries the knowledge index (scope-scoped) to gather context for a mission step; reuses the existing knowledge.search capability — no new capability invented.

seats.name: coder
seats.description: Drafts and submits new control-plane tasks (e.g. shell step, mission step); reuses task.create — composing on top of the existing executor + adapter contract.

seats.name: analyst
seats.description: Reads task detail (state, events, artifacts, stdout/stderr) to interpret results; reuses task.read — no new read path.

seats.name: reviewer
seats.description: Reviews a finished task's artifacts/events for criteria conformance; reuses task.read — same audit path as the analyst seat.

seats.name: planner
seats.description: Plans the mission by composing task.create requests (one per step); reuses task.create so plan-time gate AT-12/capability/workspace deny-by-default all apply.

seats.name: executor
seats.description: Drives a multi-step flow (Fase 2 src/flow.ts) as a single composed task via control plane; reuses flow.run — flow gates (capability per step, scope binding) apply unchanged.

seats.name: validator
seats.description: Validates side-effects/output against declared criteria; reuses task.read — does NOT mutate state (read-only by construction).

seats.name: librarian
seats.description: Ingests new authorized sources (path under dhaheros/knowledge/, scope-scoped, secret-stripped); reuses knowledge.ingest — same deny-by-default path policy.

seats.name: sentinel
seats.description: Watches for runaway tasks (timeout/budget) and cancels them via POST /api/tasks/:id/cancel; reuses task.cancel — same state-machine rules (terminal states reject cancel with 409).

seats.name: archivist
seats.description: Revokes a knowledge source (purge full descendants); reuses knowledge.revoke — same ACL double-check + immediate effective retrieval denial.

seats.name: orchestrator
seats.description: Coordinates the other 10 seats (assigns role per mission, manages org/role/member registry); reuses org.manage — the highest-privilege capability in the whitelist; AT-BH-05 enforces that only org members with org.manage in their role may claim this seat.
